function.name: act

script:
repo.edit("src/retry.rs", "= 2;", "= 3;")
res = env.run(["cargo", "test"], check = False)
out = {"new_content": repo.read("src/retry.rs"), "code": res.code, "stdout": res.stdout, "stderr": res.stderr}
if res.code != 0:
    repo.reset("src/retry.rs")
    out["reverted"] = True
    out["content_after_revert"] = repo.read("src/retry.rs")
return out
